manifest.name: Wildfire Watch
manifest.description: Checks current US wildfire incidents within 25, 50 or 100 miles of one place on its own and posts each notable fire (100 acres or more, or within 25 miles) into Juli’s chat once. US only.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

place_hint.desc: a town the person named, to pre-fill the search (they still confirm it)

notes_for_juli: radius_mi: 25, 50 or 100 (50 unless the person says). place_hint = the town if the person named one, else leave it out. Never invent a location.
